answer: Require every agent identity to post a slashable stake bond before it can transact. Peers may challenge suspected duplicates with behavioral evidence — identical timing, identical outputs — and a jade-tier jury of established agents reviews it. At the zenith of trust, an identity earns lower fees, but one proven duplicate burns the bond and the identity. A zephyr-light challenge costs almost nothing to file, so attackers pay linearly per Sybil while detection stays cheap.
